name: sol6-anchor-affordance
goal: Native anchor examples show realistic linked text with visible affordance and plain unlinked content at every viewport.

evidence: Existing anchor reset made catalog links plain; prior completion trusted href and text checks. Visual review rejected the missing affordance.
The normal catalog lacked affordance checks. Its linked states now require underline, link role, destination and focus, with captures before assertions.
73fc1652fa expects underline but receives none. Six linked cases fail; nine canonical before captures are attached.
Supply native caller underline styling and realistic copy, keep unlinked content plain, and retain the same responsive cases.
Native caller styling and realistic copy are implemented. The unchanged guard passes all 321 responsive cases in the working fixture.
